errors.evidence: For Germany, the values for Kupfer are 8.3% (2021), 11.3% (2022), and 2.2% (2023), not 11.4% for 2023 as stated.

errors.text_span: und die Balken für Nickel betragen 2,2 %, 25,1 % bzw. 24,7 %
errors.evidence: For Germany, the values for Nickel are 25.1% (2021), 24.7% (2022), and 11.4% (2023), not 2.2% for 2021 as stated.
For the EU, the values for Nickel are 24.3% (2021), 23.3% (2022), and 14.6% (2023), not 14.6% for 2021 as stated.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the chart represents the share of Russian imports of industrial raw materials in percentage terms.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the two charts are labeled 'Deutschland' and 'EU' to distinguish the data for Germany and the European Union.
